test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ANAEMIA' is written as 'AOAENIA', 'AQUEOUS' is written as 'ARUEOUT', and 'LIVELY' is written as 'MIWEMZ'. How will 'EUGENIA' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Consonant + 1, Vowels is placed as same letters.

'ANAEMIA' is written as 'AOAENIA'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5e2419ad4f4776d6fab2b0b1ab34e878bdc4e0bd3f4e502f3cf3e9a209a93d5.png] 

'AQUEOUS' is written as 'ARUEOUT'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb576f90ce0d9f6d1d3c6fba085d1e7c5496e8efe903bac90eaa3f21c8258a7b.png] 

For, 'LIVELY' is written as 'MIWEMZ'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc7ac80be41182750776dedccdb5ac0167f1354276f1b48db50b59f1e647108e.png] 

Similarly, for EUGENIA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59038bd40c7be87f0900c45a669bf2bf2f98bae43e18254b506edffb71eb3415.png] 

So, 'EUGENIA' will be written as 'EUHEOIA'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
